title: ETH Tombstones
tagline: This project is meant to be NFTs for dead crypto projects in the ethereum space
description: (Incomplete) NFT Tombstones for dead crypto projects that have been declared dead by the community. Crypto Tombstones is a tribute to the evolution of the crypto space. As projects come and go, we believe it's important to document their existence, impact, and reasons for their downfall. By doing so, future innovators can learn and the community can reflect on its journey.
how_its_made:
This is just a smart contract draft. I was not able to finish the project due to personal reasons. I'm sorry about that and I'll make sure to do better next time! 

- **On-Chain Archival**: Document dead projects on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring a permanent record.
- **IPFS Integration**: Detailed histories and data about the projects are stored off-chain on IPFS, ensuring data integrity without bloating the blockchain.
- **Community Contributions**: Users can submit projects for consideration, adding to the decentralized nature of information gathering.
- **Reflection & Learning**: By analyzing the causes of failure, future projects can avoid making the same mistakes.
